answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 51492 Country: India Title: meat of squirrel Question: Can we eat the meat of squirrel? Is it halal or haram? Answer ID: 51492 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 680/553/B=05/1435) Squirrel belongs to the specimen of vermin. It is not lawful to eat it as its meat is haram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
